|game_text=Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deploytment restrictions (and "power -1") in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to [[Bad Feeling Have I]]. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except [[Corellian Retort (V){{!}}Corellian Retort]]) are not stacked on [[Do They Have A Code Clearance? (V){{!}}Do They Have A Code Clearance?]]. Cannot be canceled. (Immune to [[Alter]].)

|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-78-Commando_Training_Klorslug-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]].
* '''Original''' ([[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deployment restrictions (and “power -1”) in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Light Side, p. 23). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Commando Training & •K'lor'slug (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “deployment” as “deploytment” (the list's straight single quotes around 'power -1' come from its HTML, which cannot hold double quotes, and are not counted as a change): “Deploy on table. If your character or non-[Independent Starship] starship in battle is about to be lost before the damage segment, it is instead lost at end of battle (if forfeited, forfeit for 0). Rebels (except Jedi or [Permanent Weapon] characters) ignore location deploytment restrictions (and 'power -1') in their game text, apply their Endor deployment modifiers at any location, and are immune to Bad Feeling Have I. Your Interrupts that retrieve exactly 1 Force (except Corellian Retort) are not stacked on Do They Have A Code Clearance?. Cannot be canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_79-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11</ref>
